edges.reason: token_ constructor parameter is assigned to the immutable _token state variable.
beneficiary_ constructor parameter is assigned to _beneficiary.
releaseStartTime_ (truncated to day boundary) is assigned to _releaseStartTime.
daysOfTimelock_ is multiplied by SECONDS_OF_A_DAY to build _releaseEndTime.
totalBenefit_ is assigned to _totalBenefit.
msg.sender is forwarded through _msgSender() into _setOwner in the constructor.
_setOwner writes the caller controlled address into _owner.
Constructor calls _setOwner(_msgSender()), setting the deployer as owner.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier compares owner() with _msgSender().
onlyOwner modifier reads msg.sender via _msgSender() for the authorization check.
terminate is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
newOwner parameter is used inside transferOwnership.
newOwner is passed into _setOwner, changing ownership.
transferOwnership calls _setOwner(newOwner).
renounceOwnership calls _setOwner(address(0)).
_setOwner copies the current _owner into the oldOwner local variable.
Constructor requires _releaseEndTime > block.timestamp, making deployment timestamp dependent.
SECONDS_OF_A_DAY is used to convert seconds into days in releasedBalance().
releasedBalance() branches on block.timestamp for vesting computation (timestamp dependency).
_releaseStartTime is read to compute elapsed days.
_releaseEndTime is read to compute the total window and full-release condition.
_totalBenefit is scaled by elapsed days inside releasedBalance().
releasedBalance() performs the multiplication/division that computes the vested amount.
passedDays feeds the vested amount arithmetic.
totalDays is the divisor of the vested amount arithmetic.
unreleasedBalance() subtracts releasedBalance() from the total benefit.
_totalBenefit is read in unreleasedBalance().
withdrawedBalance() returns _withdrawedBalance.
withdraw() requires releasedBalance() > _withdrawedBalance.
withdraw() reads _withdrawedBalance to compute the pending amount.
withdraw() increments _withdrawedBalance before transferring tokens (checks-effects-interactions).
amount is derived from releasedBalance().
amount is derived from _withdrawedBalance.
withdraw() computes the amount local variable.
Computed amount is the value passed to token().safeTransfer().
_beneficiary is the recipient passed to safeTransfer.
withdraw() calls token().balanceOf(address(this)) to validate the deposited amount.
External balanceOf result is checked against the amount before transferring.
withdraw() performs an external token transfer call after updating state.
safeTransfer hands execution to the external token contract, which can re-enter withdraw().
isNotTerminated modifier reads the _isTerminated flag.
terminate is guarded by the isNotTerminated modifier.
terminate() resets _totalBenefit to the currently released balance.
terminate() writes the _totalBenefit state variable.
terminate() reads _totalBenefit to compute unreleased funds to send to the owner.
terminate() sets _releaseEndTime from block.timestamp (timestamp dependency).
terminate() truncates _releaseEndTime to the current day boundary.
terminate() flips _isTerminated to true.
owner() is the recipient of the token transfer in terminate().
terminate() calls token().balanceOf(address(this)) to size the transfer.
External balanceOf result determines amountToWithdraw.
amountToWithdraw is the value passed to safeTransfer in terminate().
terminate() performs an external token transfer to the owner.
safeTransfer in terminate() yields control to the external token contract, enabling re-entrancy into terminate/withdraw.
